chapters.title: Directions for Lost and Found-Ring Edition

tracks.title: Directions for Lost and Found-Ring Edition

metadata.description: Step into a detective's shoes with "Lost and Found: Ring Edition," and solve the mystery of Susie's missing heirloom ring in an old hotel full of movie set-themed rooms. From jungle scenes to submarine interiors, each door opens to a new adventure. Use the printable map to track your progress through 49 potential locations. Perfect for aspiring detectives, this audio game combines mystery, excitement, and a touch of skill to engage and entertain. Ready to find the ring and solve the case?
